info.name: Insecure SSL (v2.1)
info.description: Fixture for issue #20. Requests a local HTTPS endpoint served with a self-signed certificate at `https://localhost:{{port}}/`. Reaching it requires disabling SSL validation (the `--insecure` / `insecure: true` option); otherwise Newman aborts the request with a certificate error. The `port` global variable is injected by the test.

request.description: Hits the local self-signed HTTPS server started by the test.
